sn45.153:1.1: “Bhikkhus, just as a pot that has been turned upside down gives up its water and does not take it back,
sn45.153:1.2: so a bhikkhu who develops and cultivates the Noble Eightfold Path gives up evil unwholesome states and does not take them back.
sn45.153:1.3: “And how does a bhikkhu do so?
sn45.153:1.4: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops right view … right concentration, which is based upon seclusion, dispassion, and cessation, maturing in release.
sn45.153:1.5: It is in this way, bhikkhus, that a bhikkhu develops and cultivates the Noble Eightfold Path so that he gives up evil unwholesome states and does not take them back.”
